question: to the Commission Maciej Wąsik (ECR) Subject:

Publicly available data in the Financial Transparency System show that, between 2018 and 2025, entities belonging to the DT Global group (DT Global IDEV Europe S.L., DT Global IDEV S.L.U. and DT International Development UK Ltd) received a total of EUR 235 million from the Commission for projects under various EU external instruments. This included: EUR 41.97 million under the DCI; EUR 26.85 million under the EDF; EUR 14.90 million under the EIDHR; EUR 10.61 million under the ENI; EUR 4.62 million under IPA III; EUR 3.13 million under IPA II; and smaller amounts under other instruments1. In light of the above: 1.

Please make available the full list of all projects implemented by DT Global between 2018 and 2025, together with the amounts of funding provided for the implementation of those projects. For which specific projects were those funds allocated, and what amounts were involved?
Please provide a detailed breakdown of the EUR 41.97 million received by DT Global under the DCI. For which specific projects were those funds allocated, and what amounts were involved?
Please provide a detailed breakdown of the EUR 26.85 million received under the EDF. For which specific projects were those funds allocated, and what amounts were involved?

Unfortunately, publicly available registers do not contain detailed information on the specific projects the above funds were allocated to between 2018 and 2025, nor do they show the exact amounts involved. DT Global only publishes selected projects on its website, without specifying precisely under which EU financial instrument they were implemented or the amount of funding they received.

to the Commission Maciej Wąsik (ECR) (29 April 2026) Subject: DT Global’s implementation of the Neighbourhood, Development and International Cooperation Instrument — Global Europe (NDICI — Global Europe) programme Data available publicly in the Financial Transparency System shows that entities belonging to the DT Global group received a total of EUR 130.78 million in funding from the Commission between 2018 and 2025 for the implementation of projects under the NDICI — Global Europe instrument (1). On its website, DT Global lists numerous projects funded by the Commission carried out in various regions of the world (2). Publicly available registers do not contain detailed information regarding for which specific projects and in what exact amounts the above funds were allocated between 2018 and 2025. The company only publishes selected projects on its website, without specifying precisely under which EU financial instrument they were implemented or the amount of funding they received. In light of the above:

Unfortunately, publicly available registers do not contain detailed information on the specific projects the above funds were allocated to between 2018 and 2025, nor do they show the exact amounts involved. DT Global only publishes selected projects on its website, without specifying precisely under which EU financial instrument they were implemented or the amount of funding they received. https://ec.europa.eu/budget/financial-transparency-system/analysis.html, (accessed: 24 September 2025) https://dt-global.com/projects/?_project_client=european-commission&_project_implemented_by=dt-global-europe, (accessed: 25 September 2025)

Will the Commission make publicly available a full list of all projects implemented by DT Global and its affiliates under NDICI — Global Europe, setting out for each project: the project name, country or region of implementation, contract number, amount awarded in euros, implementation period and a brief description of the objectives?
Which of the projects listed by DT Global on their website were funded by NDICI — Global Europe and in what amounts?
Has the Commission carried out audits or evaluations of the effectiveness of the implementation of projects entrusted to DT Global under NDICI — Global Europe? If so, what were the main conclusions?

Joint answer given by Mr Síkela on behalf of the European Commission (3 August 2026) Over the 2018-2025 period, there have been a total of 266 contracts signed with DT Global (legal entities: DT GLOBAL IDEV EUROPE SLU, DT INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENT UK, DT GLOBAL EMERGING MARKETS UK) for a total of EUR 234 882 436. Actions funded by the EU budget are available on the publicly accessible Financial Transparency System (1). For each action, this includes the amount of the contract information about the beneficiary country and the objective of the action. The Commission cannot comment on elements from an external source over which it has no control, such as web pages of third parties. Actions are generally not entrusted to a single private consulting firm and there are usually several contracts of various nature to implement a given action. Retrospective evaluations of actions occur on a case-by-case basis. They are conducted using methodologies that conform to international standards, particularly those of the Development Assistance Committee of the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development, with key criteria assessed including relevance, coherence, effectiveness, efficiency, sustainability, impact and EU added value. The Commission operating with the funding instruments that the Honourable Member refers to carry systematic audits linked to the verification of regularity and legality of expenditure.
